summary: All executable regression, static, protocol, and anonymous boundary checks passed, but independent GreenAgent acceptance is blocked by same-agent role continuity and missing authenticated, contract, PostgreSQL, browser, accessibility, and orientation-study handoff evidence.
observations: Backend foundation and compatibility checks passed 148 tests.
Frontend checks passed 757 tests plus lint and type checking.
Anonymous API and UI authentication negative controls passed.
No independent authenticated, PostgreSQL, browser, accessibility, or orientation fixture was handed to Tester.
Builder and Tester were the same Codex agent in a continuous context.

comparisons.expected: Anonymous project UI exposes no project data

limitations: Same-agent Builder and Tester role continuity prevents full independence.
No authenticated reference client or cross-user fixture.
No PostgreSQL concurrency or reconciliation failure-injection environment.
No authenticated Playwright, screenshot, accessibility, mobile, or orientation-study artifact.
Existing regression reruns are supporting evidence rather than independent reproduction.

results.observed: Builder-to-Tester handoff exists; the predeclared test plan passed the GreenAgent transition guard; cycle validation and doctor passed.
Anonymous GET /api/workspaces returned 401 through the unified public entry.
Anonymous /workspace/projects returned a 307 redirect to /login and exposed no project response.
The 148-test backend regression set passed and supports membership isolation, but the handoff supplied no independent authenticated cross-user fixture or reference client.
The backend regression set passed and supports duplicate-slug handling, but no independent authenticated API fixture was supplied.
Thread and migration regressions passed and support Inbox/private-owner defaults, but the handoff lacks an independent legacy backfill and rerun-idempotency fixture.
Persistence bootstrap and migration-environment regressions passed within the 148-test set; no PostgreSQL production fixture was available.
Backend foundation and compatibility set: 148 passed, 1 dependency deprecation warning.
Frontend suite: 88 files and 757 tests passed; the initial sandbox bind denial was rerun with approved local-port permission.
The anonymous authentication boundary passed, but no authenticated Playwright, screenshot, mobile, keyboard, accessibility, or orientation-task artifact was supplied.
Frontend ESLint and TypeScript check passed; focused backend Ruff check passed.
Builder report and work item explicitly retain B4-B8 as pending.

independence_assessment.reason: The same Codex agent performed Builder and Tester roles in one continuous context, so role separation did not provide independent agent/person separation. Existing regression reruns were therefore treated only as supporting evidence.

drift_findings.description: The Builder handoff does not contain the phase plan's independent fixtures, RBAC matrix, PostgreSQL evidence, browser artifacts, or orientation fixtures needed for a defensible Tester verdict.

The reused work-item acceptance criterion still says implementation files must not be modified, while later human approvals explicitly authorized implementation. The controlling acceptance contract is internally stale.
The artifact inventory contains no new B0 cross-component workspace/conversation/DBTL/knowledge/maize contract package or standalone database-authority ADR declared by the phased plan.
No independent authenticated cross-user, PostgreSQL concurrency, or failure-injection evidence was available; anonymous probes cannot validate project-level isolation or production authority.
No workspace/project Playwright flow, screenshots, responsive/mobile record, keyboard path, accessibility record, or H0/H1 orientation fixture was present.
